name: archboard-ecma
responsibility: Rounds and spells numbers exactly as JavaScript does, so the core draws what the TypeScript painter drew
description: The archboard-ecma crate (ADR 0091), 12 names: round, number, to_fixed, fixed, within, hypot, min, max, sign, pow, trim and is_space; powi stays private. js_min and js_max fold into min and max, bit for bit. The SVG spellers (a base, padding, plain decimals) live in archboard-svg's private spelling.rs, since only the SVG writes them. archboard-graphviz depends on this crate alone.
